text:
Olivia Hart: Noticed a churn spike in onboarding tickets again. Common pattern: users `redwood login` -> CLI writes ~/.redwood/token, then node quickstart returns 401 because sample apps expect REDWOOD_API_KEY. We keep fixing SDK parity ad-hoc. Can we agree a migration + deprecation plan rather than continuous bandaids?

Diego Park: Yep. We should standardize precedence (explicit creds -> REDWOOD_API_KEY -> REDWOOD_SERVICE_TOKEN -> REDWOOD_TOKEN_FILE -> keychain) but also provide a compatibility shim that logs a deprecation warning when legacy sources are used. That gives users time to migrate.

Renee Wu: I like a measured rollout. Proposal: phase 1 (now): SDKs read all sources but emit an info-level message and a telemetry event (opt-in) when the token file is used. Phase 2 (30 days): console shows a dismissible banner guiding users to set env or run `redwood login`. Phase 3 (90 days): add env-first behavior with a clear breaking warning in SDK logs, and document a migration checklist. Phase 4 (180 days): consider making env-first the documented default and keep file fallback for compatibility behind an explicit flag.

Sam Bennett: Important: for the compatibility shim, please don't print tokens. Print only the source path like "~/.redwood/token" (masked) and an action link: "run `redwood whoami`". Also add `REDWOOD_CRED_MIGRATE` env to suppress warnings for automated migrations.

Olivia Hart: UX notes: sample apps should include a small diagnostic helper that runs at startup when NODE_ENV !== 'production': it prints the effective auth_source, partial-masked key id (last 4 chars), and a suggested next-step (export REDWOOD_API_KEY or `redwood login`). Example output: 
```
Auth source: token_file (~/.redwood/token)
Key id: ****-3f4a
Hint: run `redwood whoami` or set REDWOOD_API_KEY to silence this message
```
This will cut support back-and-forth.

Diego Park: For rotation, agree on gateway header semantics: `x-rw-auth-status: expired|revoked|mfa_required`. SDKs treat expired as recoverable (try fallback once), revoked as non-recoverable (fail fast), mfa_required surfaces a `requires-mfa` error with link to console. Also add `x-rw-auth-source` in introspection endpoint so SDKs can log the authoritative source for a token (useful in hybrid infra).

Renee Wu: Operationally, let's land these in node SDK first with unit tests and a staging integration against the auth-mock. Important acceptance criteria: 1) compatibility shim with warn logging, 2) whoami CLI output, 3) sample diagnostic helper, 4) gateway header changes, 5) short migration doc + console banner.

Sam Bennett: I'll draft the migration doc and a short support playbook (common error -> how to check whoami -> remediation steps). Also recommend adding `REDWOOD_DEBUG_CRED_CHAIN` env that prints the full chain evaluation when troubleshooting (opt-in only).

devx-bot: Created RDW-11777: "Credential migration plan + SDK compatibility shim + whoami + auth header semantics" assigned to @Diego Park.

Diego Park: Taking RDW-11777. Plan: PR for node SDK this week (compat shim + tests), sample apps updated with diagnostic helper, console banner copy ready for product review. Will follow-up with python+go SDKs after node lands.
